setup: CREATE TABLE g06_text_grapheme AS SELECT CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 'á👩🏽‍💻Z' WHEN 1 THEN '🇺🇳x' WHEN 2 THEN '♥️é' ELSE '' END AS v, i FROM range(50000) t(i); CREATE TABLE g06_text_codepoint AS SELECT CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 1 THEN 65 WHEN 2 THEN 129414 ELSE 233 END AS code FROM range(50000) t(i)

workloads.name: g06_1d_grapheme_substring_length_low_cardinality_50k
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(length_grapheme(substring_grapheme(v, CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN -1 WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 1 END, CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END))) FROM g06_text_grapheme

workloads.name: g06_1d_codepoint_nul_ascii_contains_aggregate_50k
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(ascii(chr(code))), count(*) FILTER (WHERE contains('p' || chr(code) || chr(0) || 's', chr(code))) FROM g06_text_codepoint
